rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term before a noun when something shows the whole surrounding view.

example.english: This panoramic photo is very clear, and you can see the whole surrounding view.
example.traditional: 呢張全景相影得好清楚，四周嘅景色都睇得晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 cyun4 ging2 soeng1 jing2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 sei3 zau1 ge3 ging2 sik1 dou1 tai2 dak1 saai3

rows.note: Choose this for a place or view that is open and unobstructed, rather than specifically for a camera or image.

example.english: This balcony has a panoramic view of the whole bay.
example.traditional: 呢個露台夠開揚，望出去成個海灣都睇得晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 lou6 toi4 gau3 hoi1 joeng4 mong6 ceot1 heoi3 seng4 go3 hoi2 waan1 dou1 tai2 dak1 saai3

rows.note: Use this mainly for a wide-angle lens, camera, photograph, or field of view.

example.english: I used a panoramic wide-angle lens so I could fit the whole room in.
example.traditional: 我部相機換咗廣角鏡，成間房都影得落。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 soeng2 gei1 wun6 zo2 gwong2 gok3 geng3 sing4 gaan1 fong4 dou1 jing2 dak1 lok6
